p48.002: Many people think that the moment they die, they become perfect spirits. But the text calls such beliefs “⟦Q 48:0.2⟧ignorant superstitions and pleasing fables.⟦/Q⟧” God does not change a being with an animal nature into a perfect spirit in an instant, as if by magic. Between mortal and spirit there is always a long transition called the morontia life. Morontia means the stage between matter and spirit, and only by passing through it can we reach the world of spirit.
p48.004: The morontia worlds are the connecting worlds that link the material level and the spirit level. Along with the one hundred material elements, these worlds have one hundred special forms of energy called morontia materials. At first they are very much like the material world we know now, but the higher we go, the more spiritual they become.
p48.005: The morontia power supervisors provide us with 570 morontia bodies, one after another. From the time we leave the material world until we become first-stage spirits on Salvington, we change exactly 570 times. While we live in the flesh, the spirit of God within us is like a separate guest, but in the morontia life it gradually becomes a real part of our personality.
p48.007: The morontia power supervisors are children of the local universe Mother Spirit. They combine material and spiritual energies to create and maintain the surroundings of the transition worlds. They are divided into seven groups, including those who regulate the energy circuits, those who harmonize the energies of different worlds, those who manage the planets, those who change energy into matter, and those who keep records.
p48.008: The selective assorters in particular adjust our bodies and minds to fit each new setting whenever we move up to a new stage. Whenever we have grown enough spiritually, we can take a test and go on to the next stage. By the end of the morontia career, we will be able to see almost every spirit being.
p48.010: The Morontia Companions are children of the local universe Mother Spirit, and there are more than seventy billion of them in Nebadon alone. When we first wake up on the first mansion world, one of them is sure to be beside us to greet us. Some are the outgoing type and some are the quiet type, and they are affectionate, sociable beings who show touching love for one another.
p48.011: They become friends to newcomers, welcome visitors, teach social life, interpret languages, guide travelers, and take care of buildings. Even on the mansion worlds, new languages are not known automatically; they have to be learned, just as they are here. The text describes these companions as something we do not strictly need but would miss very much, the “⟦Q 48:3.18⟧personality luxury⟦/Q⟧” of our ascending career.
p48.013: There is laughter and play in heaven too. The ascending career is divided almost half and half between work and play. The reversion directors are volunteers from many kinds of beings who help their tired companions rest and laugh as they recall past memories. Heavenly humor never mocks the misfortune of the weak, and it never insults God.
p48.014: Heavenly humor has three kinds. There is laughing as we remember how clumsy we used to be, the joy of realizing that what we once worried about so seriously was really nothing much, and the gladness that comes from trusting “⟦Q 48:4.7⟧that all things work together for good⟦/Q⟧”. The text says, “⟦Q 48:4.15⟧Humor is the divine antidote for exaltation of ego.⟦/Q⟧” Learning not to take ourselves too seriously is wisdom we need right now, too.
p48.016: The Mansion World Teachers are the cherubim and sanobim who helped the guardian angels on earth. Because they lived alongside us on the inhabited worlds, they become teachers who understand us deeply. The schools of the mansion worlds are divided into schools of thinking, schools of feeling, and schools of doing.
p48.017: Whatever we could have learned on earth but did not, we will surely have to learn there. There are no shortcuts and no easy roads to Paradise. One purpose of the morontia career is to root out animal habits such as putting things off, making excuses, insincerity, avoiding problems, and always looking for the easy way. There we learn that putting things off never lets us escape them.
p48.019: The seraphim called transition ministers also help us on the mansion worlds. The seraphic evangels help us choose wisely the path we will take, and they proclaim the truth that “⟦Q 48:6.7⟧No act of good is ever wholly lost;⟦/Q⟧” This paper also includes a beautiful poem whispered to a shepherd boy, about not being afraid even in darkness and death. The racial interpreters harmonize the viewpoints of the different races, and the mind planners help us fairly so that we can see ourselves clearly. They teach that if our mind does not serve us well, we can exchange it for the mind of Jesus.
p48.020: The morontia counselors teach mota. Mota is a wisdom higher than philosophy; it is like going from seeing the world with one eye to seeing it with two and discovering depth. The recorder-teachers teach us to look not only for facts but for truth, and to water not only knowledge but the garden of the heart. They also say that while we are learning to think like adults, we must learn to pray like children.
p48.021: The angels of the reserve corps teach us how to get back up and try again when we fail, and how to accept difficulties without complaining. Sometimes the greatest disappointment turns out to be the greatest blessing. They say, “⟦Q 48:6.37⟧though the work is important, the self is not.⟦/Q⟧” What wears us out is not the work itself but the urge to put ourselves forward.
p48.023: When beginning students on the first mansion world learn mota, they first study it side by side with human philosophy. The text gives twenty-eight wise sayings used as examples. Among them: cleverness cannot take the place of true character; the weak only make resolutions, while the strong act; and the greatest affliction is never to have been afflicted.
p48.024: Many of them are especially worth taking to heart for young people. They say that impatience is a spirit poison, that anxiety must be given up, and that the hardest disappointments to bear are the ones that never come. There is also the saying “⟦Q 48:7.26⟧The acts of today are the destiny of tomorrow.⟦/Q⟧” and the saying that knowledge truly becomes yours only when you share it. It is a great comfort to hear that a soul becomes divine not by what it has achieved but by what it strives to do.
p48.026: From the time they graduate from the mansion worlds until they become spirits in the superuniverse, ascenders are called morontia progressors. The whole universe was not built as such a vast and detailed school just to take us on an eternal vacation. Beyond it lies a goal of greater service that we will take up.
p48.027: On the road from mortal to finaliter, we go from animal to angel, from angel to spirit, and from spirit to God, living through every stage of existence for ourselves. So our learning and effort here on earth right now are also a precious first step in that long journey. Taking one faithful step today is how we shape our eternal destiny.
p49.002: Every inhabited world is an evolutionary world, a cradle where mortal races are born and grow up. Every stage of the ascent is a training school for the next stage. A single local system can hold up to about a thousand inhabited worlds, but our Satania is an unfinished system with only 619 so far. Urantia is the six hundred sixth world in Satania on which human beings appeared, and many planets that will someday hold life are being prepared. Not every planet is suited for life, but many of the satellites that circle huge planets are good places for people to live. Anova, the first inhabited world of Satania, is also a satellite that circles a huge dark planet, and it now has an advanced civilization.
p49.004: Life in the universe does not appear suddenly as if by magic, but it does not appear by chance either. The Life Carriers start life on each planet, and its development follows law and order. Life may begin in three places, as on Urantia, or in just one, and on worlds with an atmosphere it usually begins in the seas. No two worlds have exactly the same plants and animals. Plants always appear before animals, and every animal develops from the basic patterns of the plant life that came before it.
p49.005: The text states clearly, “⟦Q 49:1.6⟧Mortal man is not an evolutionary accident.⟦/Q⟧” It also gives the example that mice reproduce faster than elephants, yet elephants evolve faster than mice. Evolution happens in an orderly way, according to plan and purpose. That is why, when superior strains of life appear, they should be carefully protected.
p49.007: The Life Carriers adjust the design of life a little to suit the environment of each planet. So there are many types of mortals, depending on things such as the atmosphere, where they live, gravity, temperature, electrical conditions, and how they get their energy. We Urantia people are mid-breathers who breathe an ordinary atmosphere, and we are of the land type, living on the ground.
p49.008: On some worlds the first civilizations begin in the treetops or in shallow water. People on large planets are short, and people on small planets are tall, so the average height of Nebadon mortals is close to seven feet. Some peoples are made to fit hot places or cold places. But these physical differences have no effect at all on the mind or the spiritual life.
p49.010: There are also nonbreathers who live on planets with almost no atmosphere. Satania has only nine such worlds, because there are still many wandering meteors in this region, and a world without an atmosphere is left wide open to meteor attack. The people there have to protect themselves from meteors with electrical devices, and the way they eat and drink is completely different from ours. Yet like us they go through the trials and joys of life, and their minds and characters are no different from those of other mortals. The text tells us that such people even live not far from Urantia.
p49.012: All mortals who have wills walk on two feet. There are basically six races: red, yellow, blue, orange, green, and indigo. Children are usually born one at a time, and family life is much the same on every world. The text says that on all advanced worlds men and women are equal in mind and spiritual status, and that as long as one sex tries to dominate the other, a planet has not yet come out of barbarism.
p49.013: Life spans range from twenty-five years on primitive worlds to almost five hundred years on advanced ones. Bodies may differ, but mind is a gift of the Infinite Spirit, so it works in much the same way everywhere. But the human mind cannot survive on its own. Only when an immortal soul grows, together with the Thought Adjuster who lives within us, can we survive.
p49.015: Mortals can be grouped in several ways. Urantia is an experimental planet where the Life Carriers test new designs of life, so it has many kinds of life found nowhere else, while some common species are missing. By brain structure, there are one-brained, two-brained, and three-brained types. Urantia people are two-brained, and they tend to be rich in imagination, a spirit of adventure, and philosophical leanings. The three-brained types are more spiritual and ethical, but all three types are equal in the ascending career. Differences in spiritual receptivity also apply only to life in the flesh, and they disappear after death.
p49.016: On a normal world, a Planetary Prince, an Adam and Eve, Magisterial Sons, a bestowal Son, and Teacher Sons come one after another to guide the planet, and at last it reaches the age of light and life. Urantia went through confusion because its Planetary Prince, Caligastia, rebelled and Adam and Eve failed. But our world has had the outstanding honor of being the place where Michael, the sovereign of Nebadon, was born as a human being.
p49.018: All mortals receive the same help from the Thought Adjuster and the guardian angels, and most of them go on to the morontia worlds by way of natural death. Those who are less spiritually developed sleep until a new age begins and then wake up together. Those who have grown a great deal personally and have received a personal guardian angel of their own wake up on the mansion worlds on the third day after death. Those who are even further along sometimes skip several mansion worlds, but later they must go back there to serve as teachers.
p49.019: On the most advanced worlds, some people fully fuse with their Thought Adjusters while still alive and are taken directly, without going through death. The longer a world has been settled in light and life, the rarer natural death becomes. No matter what world we are born on or what we look like, the way to God is wide open to everyone, and that is a truly great hope.
p50.002: A Planetary Prince is a Son of the universe who takes charge of ruling one inhabited planet. Planetary Princes belong to the large group called the Lanonandek Sons, but they are so specialized in caring for a single planet that they are thought of as a group of their own. They are trained and approved by the Melchizedeks, and after carrying out various assignments for the System Sovereign, they are finally appointed as Planetary Princes. When the Life Carriers plant life on a planet and beings who can think appear there, a request goes up for an administrative head to lead that planet. Then a Planetary Prince is sent. In this way, one Planetary Prince is assigned to every planet where evolving people live.
p50.004: The Planetary Prince is the personal Son, on the side of the Eternal Son of Paradise, who comes closest to us human beings. The angels come from the Infinite Spirit, and the Thought Adjusters (the spirit of God who lives in our minds) come from the Universal Father, but the Planetary Prince represents the last effort of the Eternal Son and his Sons to reach us. On a world where people have just begun to live, he is the only one who represents God.
p50.005: Planetary Princes are chosen from beings close to humans so that they can understand human difficulties well. But that very fact also brings a danger. Representing God alone on one planet, a Prince can easily come to think he is too important, and he may put his own ideas ahead of the wishes of those above him. In fact, rebellions have broken out several times in the universe of Nebadon. Still, most Planetary Princes do their work splendidly and prepare their planets well for the Material Sons and Paradise Sons who will come later.
p50.007: The Planetary Prince is under Gabriel, who handles the administration of the whole universe, and closer at hand he follows the orders of the System Sovereign. When needed, he can ask advice from his old teachers, the Melchizedeks, but unless he asks, the Melchizedeks do not step in. In a planet’s early days, the government mostly works by the Prince making the decisions himself. A Prince usually has a supreme council of twelve and works with a staff of about a thousand on average, and as the planet develops, his helpers may grow to more than a hundred thousand.
p50.008: Every planet has courts that deal with justice. The judgments of these courts show a fatherly, generous attitude more than a harsh one. Even so, no judgment that takes away someone’s life is ever carried out without the consent of the Constellation Father. As The Urantia Book puts it, the “⟦Q 50:2.6⟧Most Highs rule in the kingdoms of men.⟦/Q⟧” In special cases, angels or Melchizedeks may even appear so that people can see them.
p50.010: When a Planetary Prince goes to a young world, he takes with him ascenders who volunteered from the system headquarters. Ascenders are beings who lived as humans, came back to life after death, and are walking the path up to God. The Life Carriers make new material bodies for them. These bodies do not catch diseases, but they can be hurt in accidents. These helpers serve as a bridge between the Prince and the people of the planet, and they are called the Prince’s corporeal staff. Caligastia, the Prince of Urantia, brought one hundred such helpers with him.
p50.011: The members of the corporeal staff married one another and had children, and from among those children midway creatures (beings between humans and angels) sometimes came into being. When the Prince’s age is over, they lay aside their material bodies, wake up in morontia bodies (bodies for the stage between matter and spirit), and return to the system capital. They fall one age behind their classmates, but in return they gain a very rare and valuable experience.
p50.013: The corporeal staff set up schools at the planetary headquarters early on. They bring outstanding young people from the various tribes, teach them, and then send them back home to pass on what they have learned. In the headquarters settlement on Urantia, everyone received plenty of land, and both students and teachers farmed. Their time was evenly divided among physical work, social activities, study, job training, and spiritual learning. There were also schools that taught about marriage and family, and schools of art and crafts.
p50.014: Because the Planetary Prince cannot be seen by people, simply believing what the staff said was itself a test of faith. Even so, people competed to get into these schools, and their influence slowly spread across the whole world. But when Caligastia joined the Lucifer rebellion, all this suddenly collapsed. He deliberately twisted and corrupted the teachings of the schools. Yet many of the staff’s descendants stayed loyal, and thanks to them spiritual truth never completely disappeared from Urantia.
p50.016: A loyal Planetary Prince stays forever on the planet first given to him and helps its civilization grow. Every planet develops differently, but all evolutionary worlds generally pass through seven epochs in turn. The first is the nutrition epoch, when people put all their strength into finding food; the second is the security age, when they work hard to protect themselves; and the third is the material-comfort era, when they look for ease and luxury.
p50.017: The fourth is the age of the quest for knowledge and wisdom, when education becomes the watchword. The fifth is the epoch of philosophy and brotherhood, when people think deeply, live morally, and follow the golden rule. The sixth is the age of spiritual striving, when religion leaves fear and superstition behind and rises to true spiritual experience. The last, the seventh, is the era of light and life, when all of these bloom together as one. When this era begins, the Planetary Prince is raised to the position of Planetary Sovereign.
p50.019: Because Urantia is cut off from other worlds by the rebellion, the text cannot tell us much about life on our neighboring planets. Compared with the loyal worlds, our planet looks far behind and confused, both intellectually and spiritually. But we should not imagine that other worlds are like comfortable flower gardens. Every world faces hard struggles at first, and effort and determination are always needed.
p50.020: Culture depends on the quality of mind. If minds do not grow, culture cannot improve either. Our world is still walking a rough road because of two tragedies: a rebel Planetary Prince and a Material Son who failed. Even after Michael came to this earth, those results did not disappear all at once.
p50.022: At first glance, isolated Urantia seems like the most unfortunate of worlds. But this isolation actually becomes a special opportunity, because it lets us develop a faith in God that does not lean on what we can see. People who ascend from worlds like this are given, early on, special assignments where unshakable faith is essential.
p50.023: On Jerusem they are called agondonters. The word means people who believe without seeing, who hold out to the end even when they are alone, and who overcome difficulties. This name stays with them even after they reach Paradise. Each of your days, when you believe in what is good and keep walking steadily even without visible proof, is time spent growing the agondonter faith that the universe treasures.
p51.002: As the age of the Planetary Prince goes on, primitive humanity reaches the limit of how far it can rise through natural evolution. Then the System Sovereign sends a pair of Material Sons and Daughters to that planet. They are biologic uplifters who raise the bodies and the inborn nature of the human race one step higher, and on the planets they are usually called Adam and Eve. They are the Creator Son's material gift to the inhabited worlds. The plan of the Adam and Eve who came to Urantia went badly wrong, but their mission was not in vain. Our world has received more help from them than we can count.
p51.003: 1. Origin and Nature of the Material Sons of God
p51.004: Material Sons and Daughters are made directly by the Creator Son. He creates only one pair of these beings for each system, and he tunes them to fit the life pattern of that system. They are about eight to ten feet tall, and their bodies give off a violet glow. Adam and Eve are equal to each other, yet as male and female they complete each other, and they do almost everything together.
p51.005: They do eat food, but they live on without dying by receiving a special energy of the universe. If they fail in their mission or join a rebellion, though, their connection with that energy is cut off, and in the end they die. Material Sons do not have a Thought Adjuster (the spirit of God who lives within our minds), but by serving on a planet they earn the right to receive one. They are the sons of God whom people can see, and they link the spiritual world with the material world. The children they have on a planet live shorter lives with each passing generation.
p51.007: When word comes that a planet has reached the peak of its physical evolution, the System Sovereign calls the Material Sons and Daughters together. From among those who volunteer, one Adam and one Eve are chosen, and they fall into a deep sleep. Because they are semimaterial beings, angels cannot carry them just as they are, so first their bodies must go through a process of dematerializing. This preparation takes about three days.
p51.008: When they arrive on the planet, the Life Carriers rebuild their bodies. This process takes from ten to twenty-eight days, and the whole time they lie asleep, feeling nothing. When they wake up, they stand on the new world looking exactly as they did before. Once an Adam and Eve have come to a planet, they are meant not to leave that world during its evolutionary ages.
p51.010: Adam and Eve first build a garden home, which they name the Garden of Eden in honor of Edentia, the capital of the constellation. Their main task is to have children and so lift up the human race. For this reason, for many generations they do not mix with the native peoples but build a strong people of their own, and this is the beginning of the violet race. On Urantia, however, the rebel Prince Caligastia cleverly worked against them, and in the end Adam and Eve broke the trust they had been given. Still, they did not join the Lucifer rebellion.
p51.011: The voice in the Garden that rebuked Adam and Eve for their mistake was not God's but that of Solonia, the chief of the angels who help the planet. Also, among Adam's descendants there arise the invisible secondary midway creatures, who greatly help civilization. Our world has been visited by the Planetary Prince Caligastia, by Adam and Eve, by Machiventa Melchizedek, the sage of Salem, and by Christ Michael. Not every world is as unfortunate as Urantia, and successful Adams serve for a long time as the visible leaders of their planets.
p51.013: On an inhabited world, six colored races usually appear. The red man appears first, followed by the orange, yellow, green, blue, and indigo races. The Urantia Book explains that this division into several races opens up many different possibilities for humankind, and that later, when they blend with the violet race of Adam, it benefits the whole human family.
p51.014: In the early ages it was common for more advanced peoples to make use of less advanced ones, and so slavery arose. But on a normal world this kind of slavery is soon ended when the violet race arrives. On Urantia the plan to blend the races in harmony and lift them up was never properly carried out, so it is hard to picture an average world just by looking at how things are today.
p51.015: 5. Racial Amalgamation—Bestowal of the Adamic Blood
p51.016: The violet race usually does not mix with the native peoples until it numbers more than a million. On a normal world Adam and Eve themselves do not marry natives; their children take on this work. Outstanding men and women from many peoples come to the Garden and, of their own free will, marry Adam's descendants, and they count this as the highest honor. They promise to be married to one person only, in monogamy.
p51.017: When Adam's blood is added to humanity in this way, a new age of progress begins, and in a hundred thousand years the world moves ahead more than in the million years before. On Urantia this plan broke down early, but since Adam's life was passed on there has been great progress. Now we must work out the task of making humanity better mainly through human wisdom and effort.
p51.019: On a normal world the Garden of Eden remains a fine cultural center for a long time, and together with the Planetary Prince's headquarters city it sets the pace of civilization. The Prince's schools mainly teach philosophy, religion, and morals, while the Garden schools teach things like practical skills, economics, trade, and civil government. Adam and Eve can see the invisible Planetary Prince and the spirit beings, so they become the last link connecting God and human beings.
p51.020: As time passes, Adam and Eve come to be accepted as the common ancestors of all humanity. People come to know seven fathers, one after another: starting with their physical father, then the Planetary Adam, the System Sovereign, the Constellation Father, the Creator Son who is the father of the universe, the Ancients of Days of the superuniverse, and finally the Universal Father of Paradise.
p51.022: Later, when an Avonal Son of Paradise comes as a Magisterial Son, the planet is ruled jointly by three Sons: the Planetary Prince, the Material Son, and the Magisterial Son. At this time the education and administration of the Prince and of Adam are merged into one, and a new and efficient order comes about. After the Magisterial Son leaves, Adam and Eve lead the planet, and when the age of light and life comes, the Prince becomes the Planetary Sovereign. Smaller capitals are also set up in many places.
p51.023: The Prince takes care of spiritual and philosophical matters, while Adam and Eve take care of things like science and economics, and both work hard to develop the arts and society. The Urantia Book says that if we could see a world so well governed, we would soon understand what we lost because of the rebellion. Rather than grieving over what was lost, our part is to build a better world with our own hands, starting now.
p52.002: From the time life first begins on a planet until it finally reaches the age of light and life (the age when a planet is fully settled and enjoys peace and spiritual achievement), humanity passes through at least seven epochs. These epochs are marked off by the visits of the Sons of God, who come to the planet one after another. There is the time before and after the Planetary Prince comes, the time after Adam comes, after the Magisterial Son comes, after the bestowal Son comes, after the Teacher Sons come, and then the age of light and life. The time from when life is first planted until human beings appear is called the prehuman era.
p52.004: The age of primitive man runs from the time human beings rise above the animals and can choose for themselves whether to worship the Creator, until the Planetary Prince arrives. During this time the six colored races appear one after another, beginning with the red man. Primitive man was a mighty hunter and a fierce fighter, and the law was that the strongest survived. This age was long and dark, but The Urantia Book says that life in this age, too, is a glorious and heroic chapter.
p52.005: Primitive people lived in caves, but they soon learned to handle fire and make tools, and they overcame the great animals. On some planets large, intelligent birds that could carry people far through the air were a great help, and the distant ancestors of Urantia also had help from such birds. By the time they learn to speak, human beings gain the moral will to judge right from wrong, and they receive a Thought Adjuster (the spirit of God who lives within our minds). Religion in this age was a mixture of fear and superstition, but it softened their rough nature and became the field where the seeds of true religion would later be sown.
p52.007: When the Planetary Prince comes, government begins on earth and society develops greatly. This age lasts about half a million years on average. The Prince and his staff teach the truths of the universe for the first time, and from then on religion grows not only from within people themselves but also through revelation given from above. But the Planetary Prince is not a Prince of Peace, so wars between races and tribes only lessen; they go on.
p52.008: The greatest social achievement of this age is the rise of the home. Men and women become fully equal, and the golden age of the home begins. The wandering life of hunting changes into a settled life of farming, and the raising of animals also develops quickly. The Urantia Book says that normal worlds work hard in this age to build up the health of humanity's bodies and minds. At the same time it adds that there are always plenty of chances to show generosity and love of neighbor to those who need help.
p52.010: When human beings reach the highest point of their physical evolution, Adam and Eve come. Their greatest purpose is to help people move from hunting and herding to farming and gardening. When Adam's blood is mixed in, intelligence rises and spiritual growth speeds up. This age is an age of great inventions, machines, and exploration. The Urantia Book says that our world is now in such an age of scientific progress, but that it is more than one age behind the average planet.
p52.011: Near the end of the Adamic age the races have blended almost into one, becoming a single people with olive-colored skin tinged with violet. Nationalism grows weaker and brotherhood grows among people, education spreads around the world, and a common language is used. Interest in art, music, literature, and true philosophy awakens. When wars stop and peace comes to the whole world, that is the sign that it is time for the Magisterial Son to come.
p52.013: The Magisterial Son is an Avonal Son who comes from Paradise. This age begins with no problems of race or skin color, with all peoples having become one blood. After the Magisterial Son's visit, people become economically free and can make a living by working only about two and a half hours a day. People use the free time this gives them to grow as persons and to improve the world.
p52.014: Government gradually develops into the best form of self-rule, and most people receive Thought Adjusters. By the end of this age, life that had been complicated becomes simple and natural instead, and art, music, and learning flourish. Then a great spiritual awakening takes place across the whole world, and this is the sign that it is time for the bestowal Son to come. When needed, Magisterial Sons may come more than once.
p52.016: When a world has grown spiritually ripe, a Paradise bestowal Son comes in human form. Usually an Avonal Son comes, but just once in a local universe the Creator Son comes himself. Michael of Nebadon's coming to Urantia was exactly that case, and out of nearly ten million worlds only one receives such a gift. On Urantia, though, unlike the usual order, he came near the end of the Adamic age.
p52.017: The bestowal Son lives and dies to lift people up spiritually, and he opens the “⟦Q 52:5.4⟧new and living way⟦/Q⟧”. Because of the rebellion, those who died on Urantia could not go straight on to the next world but had to sleep and wait, but since Pentecost they can once again go straight on. After the bestowal Son leaves, the Spirit of Truth is poured out, and everyone who reaches the age of moral choice receives a Thought Adjuster. In this age the golden rule is truly practiced, disease is nearly conquered, and the length of life goes beyond three hundred years.
p52.019: On a normal world the time after the bestowal Son is an age when the whole world enjoys peace. But it was not so on Urantia. Jesus himself told his disciples ahead of time that there would be “⟦Q 52:6.1⟧wars and rumors of wars⟦/Q⟧”. In a troubled place like our world, it takes more time and effort before all people become brothers, and religious revelation is truly needed.
p52.020: For this, The Urantia Book names five things: social brotherhood, as people grow closer through travel and contact; intellectual exchange, as they share their thoughts and literature; ethical awakening, as they realize that prejudice and hatred are wrong; political wisdom, as they settle problems by law instead of by war; and spiritual insight, as they realize that God is the Father of all. The Urantia Book says that understanding one another and loving one another as brothers is the greatest force for lifting up civilization.
p52.022: Next the Trinity Teacher Sons come in groups. They stay for more than a thousand years and lead the planet into the age of light and life. Because Jesus promised to come again to Urantia, no one knows when that return will be. In this age the revelation of truth widens all the way to Paradise, and the kingdom of heaven begins to appear on earth. More and more people become one with their Thought Adjusters and are translated without passing through death, and the length of life approaches five hundred years.
p52.023: People work only about one hour a day, take great interest in the universe broadcasts, and live lives of self-government. Even so, people are still finite, and nothing is perfect. Every planet, even one that has gone through sin and rebellion, will in the end reach the age of light and life by the grace of God. Our world, too, is on that road, and our small efforts to understand and love one another are a force that brings that day closer.
p53.002: Lucifer was a truly brilliant Lanonandek Son in the universe of Nebadon. He was wise, bright, and good at his work, and he was chosen as one of the hundred most able among more than seven hundred thousand of his fellows. Yet he fell into pride and wrong thinking and embraced sin. Nebadon has ten thousand systems, but so far only three System Sovereigns have rejected the rule of the Creator Son, and Lucifer is one of them.
p53.004: Lucifer was the Sovereign of the system of Satania, which has 607 inhabited worlds, and he ruled from its capital, Jerusem. But as the words say, “⟦Q 53:1.3⟧Your heart was lifted up because of your beauty⟦/Q⟧”; he fell by gazing only at himself. On Urantia his first assistant, Satan, became better known than Lucifer, because Lucifer left the affairs of this planet to Satan.
p53.005: The being people usually call the devil is Caligastia, who was the Planetary Prince of Urantia until he was cast out. His chief of staff was Abaddon, and the leader of the rebel midway creatures was Beelzebub. The dragon became a word that stands for all these leaders of rebellion. When Michael was on this earth, Lucifer, Satan, and Caligastia joined forces to try to bring him down, but they failed completely.
p53.007: Lucifer and Satan ruled Jerusem for more than half a million years, and then in their hearts they began to set themselves against the Universal Father and Michael. There were no special conditions in Satania that stirred up rebellion. No one urged Lucifer to rebel; the idea came from his own mind alone. Over several months he won Satan over.
p53.008: The Urantia Book says it is hard to point to the exact cause of the rebellion, but one thing is clear: there was a pride that had grown so great it deceived itself. At first Lucifer may have believed he was doing what was right for the system. But once he had gone too far, his pride would not let him stop, and in the end it became sin done knowingly. Michael gave him a long time to turn back, but he scorned that mercy and refused it.
p53.010: Lucifer put out what he called a declaration of liberty, and it made three claims. First, he said that the Universal Father does not really exist and is a story made up by the Paradise Sons. Second, he said that each system should govern itself, and that neither Michael nor the Ancients of Days of the superuniverse had any right to interfere. He even claimed that anyone with enough courage could stand up to these rulers, and that all beings are by nature immortal.
p53.011: Third, he mocked the ascension plan, in which human beings rise to Paradise after death through long training, calling it a waste of time and a fiction. He said ascenders should enjoy the freedom to decide anything for themselves. With this declaration Lucifer stepped onto the path of darkness and death.
p53.013: This declaration was announced about two hundred thousand years ago at the yearly conclave on Jerusem. Satan called Lucifer the “⟦Q 53:4.1⟧God of liberty⟦/Q⟧” and cried out that loyalty belonged to him alone. Self-assertion was the battle cry of the rebellion, and Lucifer claimed that “⟦Q 53:4.4⟧majorities rule⟦/Q⟧” and that “⟦Q 53:4.4⟧mind is infallible⟦/Q⟧”. His entire staff followed him.
p53.014: The rulers of the universe did not stop him right away. Lucifer boasted that this proved the universe government had no power. But Gabriel said that every being would choose freely, and that the government for the Father wants only loyalty that comes from the heart. Instead, the rebellion was confined within the system of Satania. Great confusion went on for several years, and it was a hard time of testing for the loyal ones.
p53.016: Michael chose not to step into this rebellion himself. At that time he had not yet finished his bestowal careers, so he did not yet hold full sovereignty over his universe. For this reason the rebels moved freely for nearly two hundred thousand years. Instead, Gabriel went to Jerusem to lead the loyal hosts, and he raised Michael's banner, three azure blue concentric circles on a white field. Lucifer's banner was a white field with a red circle, and a black circle in its center.
p53.017: This is the “⟦Q 53:5.6⟧war in heaven⟦/Q⟧” that the Bible speaks of. This fight was not fought with swords and weapons. Lucifer gave speeches without end, Gabriel exposed his lies one by one, and the people went back and forth between the two sides and made up their own minds. The Urantia Book says this conflict was far more terrible than a physical war, because what was at stake was not the life of the body but eternal life.
p53.019: During the rebellion many kept their loyalty, and the most moving of them was Manotia, the second in command of the seraphim (angels). When the chief of the seraphim was blinded by Lucifer's dazzling personality and followed him, many angels thought such a shining being could not be wrong and went over with him.
p53.020: But Manotia refused to take part in insulting Michael. The rebels tried to harm him, but not one loyal angel was hurt. With the help of the Melchizedeks, the Material Sons, and the ascending mortals on Jerusem, he held out to the end, until the new Sovereign arrived. He is still serving on Urantia today.
p53.022: In Satania thirty-seven Planetary Princes joined the rebellion. But on a planet called Panoptia, a young woman named Ellanora led the people, and not a single one of them followed Lucifer. When the rebellion broke out, Satania was cut off from communication with the other worlds. None of the Melchizedeks, archangels, Trinitized Sons, or beings from Paradise went over, but a number of the angels and many Material Sons did.
p53.023: The amazing fact is that not a single ascending mortal living on Jerusem, that is, not one of its citizens who had once been human, took part in the rebellion. When the new Sovereign, Lanaforge, arrived, his first message was, “⟦Q 53:7.12⟧Not a single Jerusem citizen was lost.⟦/Q⟧” This showed that the experience of living as a human being is the strongest shield against sin. The rebels lost their authority, and after that not one more world was lost in Satania.
p53.024: 8. The Son of Man on Urantia
p53.025: The last time Lucifer and Satan came to Urantia together was when they tried to tempt Jesus, the Son of Man. The moment Jesus answered, “⟦Q 53:8.4⟧Get you behind me, Satan.⟦/Q⟧” the Lucifer rebellion was, in principle, over. This is also what Jesus meant when he said, “⟦Q 53:8.3⟧And I beheld Satan fall as lightning from heaven.⟦/Q⟧” Before he left, Michael offered mercy to Caligastia as well, but he refused.
p53.026: Since Pentecost the rebels have lost their power before the Thought Adjusters and the Spirit of Truth. The Urantia Book says clearly that no fallen spirit has the power to invade the mind of a child of God. Faith is strong armor against sin. When people do wrong, it is usually not because of a devil but because they follow the wrong tendencies within themselves.
p53.028: From the very beginning of the rebellion, Michael promised forgiveness to all who would sincerely turn back. None of the leaders accepted, but thousands of angels and hundreds of Material Sons and Daughters accepted that mercy. Now Lucifer and Satan are held on the prison worlds, waiting for the final verdict of the superuniverse courts.
p53.029: The seven prison worlds of Satania quietly tell the whole universe the truth “⟦Q 53:9.8⟧that within every sin is concealed the seed of its own destruction⟦/Q⟧”. The story of Lucifer shows that even the most gifted being can fall if he gives in to pride. True freedom is not doing whatever we please; it lies in trusting God and choosing rightly in love.
p54.002: People find it hard to understand what evil, error, sin, and iniquity are. The Urantia Book tells them apart like this. In a universe where perfection and imperfection exist side by side, evil is possible. Where truth and falsehood clash, error can arise. Choosing evil on purpose is sin, and going on and on after sin and error is iniquity. God does not create evil, nor does he permit sin and rebellion. It is only that wherever there are imperfect beings who are free to choose between good and evil, sin becomes possible.
p54.004: The greatest confusion the Lucifer rebellion left behind came from failing to tell true liberty from false liberty. True liberty is the reward won at the end of long growth, and it always keeps in mind justice, fairness, brotherhood, and one's duty to God. On the other hand, a freedom that does whatever it wants with no self-control destroys itself. The Urantia Book says, “⟦Q 54:1.5⟧License masquerading in the garments of liberty is the forerunner of abject bondage.⟦/Q⟧”
p54.005: True liberty bears fruit in ruling oneself and leads on to serving others. False liberty begins with putting oneself forward and ends up using others. Since even God respects our freedom to choose, how could anyone use his own freedom as an excuse to take away the rights of other people? Only true liberty can go hand in hand with love and mercy.
p54.007: When God made the universe, he shared the work with the Son and the Spirit, and this pattern of sharing still goes on today. Every creature who wants to do the Father's will is called to take part, as a partner of the Creators, in the great adventure of bringing the universe to completion. That is why God gives us free will and is with us within, as spirit.
p54.008: Lucifer's mistake was trying to skip this long time of growth. His crime was trying to rob every being in Satania of the joy of growing on their own and adding something of their own to the completion of the universe. His declaration was dressed up as liberty, but in fact it was an attempt to steal liberty. No being in the universe can take away from another the right to love and be loved, or the right to worship God and serve his neighbor.
p54.010: People often ask why a wise God lets evil and sin go on. But for creatures to be truly free, there must also be the possibility of choosing wrong. The ability to choose between good and evil is not just an idea; it is a gift that is really given, and the rulers of the universe let no one take this freedom away.
p54.011: When someone becomes completely one with sin, in the end that being simply ceases to exist. But there must be enough time between the moment sin is chosen and the moment its result arrives. That way the verdict looks fair to everyone, and the sinner himself can admit that it is right. The Ancients of Days do not wipe anyone out as long as even a little good value remains in that being.
p54.013: Then why were Lucifer and Satan left to do harm for so long? Any parent who has raised children can understand. As in the story of the prodigal son that Jesus told, a loving father waits a long, long time for a child who has gone wrong to come home. If that waiting can lead to repentance, then a delay in justice is well worth it.
p54.014: Most of the freedom Lucifer wanted was something he already had or was soon going to receive. But he impatiently wanted it right now, and by ignoring the rights of others he lost everything. It was the mercy of Michael, the Creator-father, that delayed judgment. This time between sowing and reaping becomes, for the good, a time to build character, and for those who have gone wrong, a chance to turn back. The Urantia Book says that in a universe ruled by mercy, justice may be slow, but it is sure.
p54.016: The Urantia Book gives some of the reasons judgment was delayed. Those who had gone wrong needed time to make their attitude fully clear; a loving father is in no hurry to punish; and justice never destroys what mercy can save. Also, at that time Michael did not yet hold full sovereignty over his universe. Above all, every being needed the chance to watch the rebellion to the end, see what it really was, and choose for itself.
p54.017: There was also advice that crushing the rebellion by force and in haste might actually lead three times as many beings astray. Bringing evil fully into the open instead of hiding it was the fastest way to heal it. Besides, time depends on where you stand. Seen through the eyes of the superuniverse, the judgment of Lucifer began only about two and a half seconds after he sinned. The Urantia Book says there are as many as forty-eight such reasons, and probably just as many that are not known.
p54.019: All these ways of dealing with the rebels show the love of God. In a family, when mercy is shown to a child who has done wrong, the other children may also go through some hardship for a while. Families, nations, and worlds are linked together, so we sometimes suffer together because of someone else's wrongdoing. But such suffering lasts only a little while, and another person's wrongdoing can never take away even a bit of our eternal future or our right to come to God.
p54.020: At first the Lucifer rebellion looked like a terrible disaster. But as time went on, good fruit came from it. Those who passed the test rose to higher places and grew more spiritually. The Melchizedeks now teach that the good that came out of this rebellion is more than a thousand times greater than all the evil put together. We, too, when facing things we cannot understand right away, can learn to wait in faith that God leads all things toward good, instead of rushing to judge.
p55.002: The age of light and life is the final goal that an evolving world reaches. A world passes through the ages of primitive man, the Planetary Prince, Adam, the Magisterial Son, the bestowal Son, and the Teacher Sons in turn, and then at last it enters this settled age. Once this age begins, it goes on without end. The age of light and life also has seven stages, starting with the planet and growing wider and wider: the system, the constellation, the local universe, the minor sector, the major sector, and the superuniverse stage.
p55.004: When a morontia temple appears at the capital of a world, it is the proof that the planet has entered the age of light and life. Morontia means the stage between matter and spirit. On this day the bestowal Son who once came to that planet comes in person and proclaims the Planetary Prince, who has served for so long, to be the Planetary Sovereign. The temples are spoken of as “⟦Q 55:1.3⟧coming down from heaven⟦/Q⟧”, but in fact they are built on the planet from plans drawn up at the system capital.
p55.005: In the center of the temple is the sanctuary of the bestowal Son; on the right is the seat of the Planetary Sovereign, and on the left the seat of the chief of the finaliters (ascenders who reached Paradise and then came back to serve). This temple, which holds about three hundred thousand people, is not a place of worship. It is used for special ceremonies, quiet meditation, graduations, and for watching people pass, while still alive, into morontia beings.
p55.007: In the age of light and life many people do not die but go straight from the life of the body into the morontia life. This happens when the soul becomes one with the Thought Adjuster (the spirit of God within us). When that time draws near, the person says goodbye to family and friends and goes to the temple, and there, surrounded by loved ones, departs in spiritual flames.
p55.008: In earlier times people wept and mourned as they laid their loved ones in the ground, but on such worlds “⟦Q 55:2.5⟧funerals⟦/Q⟧” are occasions full of joy and hope, like a graduation or a day of receiving a great award. The Urantia Book says it would help us greatly if we, too, learned to look at death with such a bright heart. By the fourth stage, more than half of the people are translated in this way while still alive.
p55.010: In this age a world prospers with one language, one religion, and usually one race. Still, it is not perfect; there are hospitals, and accidents and old age are still there. But if we were suddenly taken there, we would call it heaven on earth. On one world The Urantia Book describes, every working person gave ten percent of his income, using three percent each for truth, beauty, and goodness, and setting aside one percent against hard times.
p55.011: On that world the highest honor was the order of “⟦Q 55:3.8⟧supreme service⟦/Q⟧”. Many public duties were shared by men and women together, and children learned truth, beauty, and goodness through happy competition with one another. Even on such a world, the choice between good and evil is still there. The Urantia Book says that the biggest obstacles keeping Urantia from such an age are disease, war, and the division into many languages and races.
p55.013: When the morontia temple is set up, the finaliters, who reached Paradise and then came back to help their brothers, begin taking a real part in the planet's affairs. In the first stage the Planetary Sovereign, the chief of the finaliters, and Adam and Eve rule together. At this time the midway creatures, who had been invisible until then, become visible to people and serve as interpreters.
p55.014: As the stages go higher, the way of governing changes too. By about the third stage, a mortal chief executive chosen by the people leads the world together with the Planetary Sovereign. Adam and Eve can step away from their long mission and begin their journey to Paradise, and by the seventh stage all of them are released from this mission. The finaliters work at opening up new social, cultural, and spiritual activities.
p55.016: In the higher stages of light and life, material progress reaches its peak. Poverty and inequality have almost disappeared, and crime is rare. War has become a story in history books, and there is no army or police. Because people govern themselves, law and government become less and less needed. The Urantia Book says that the more moral and spiritual people are, the fewer legal controls there are.
p55.017: Schools work at training the mind and enlarging the soul, and art and music flourish. There is plenty of play and humor, and people compete happily to excel in the studies that help them understand the universe. Life is refreshingly simple, and the very search for happiness becomes a joy.
p55.019: People on such worlds become more generous and brotherly, yet their love for their families does not lessen at all. They are still mortals who breathe, eat, and sleep. Such a world is not heaven; it is a preview of the divine worlds we will meet in the future. People come into deeper and deeper fellowship with the Thought Adjuster within their minds.
p55.020: The Urantia Book says that physical progress has a limit, but the growth of wisdom will have no end. It also says that all this wonderful progress takes place before a person even begins the morontia life. The Urantia Book says that if we could see just one such world, we would never again doubt the wisdom of the plan of creation.
p55.022: The first stage lasts from the time the morontia temple is set up until the whole system reaches light and life. At this time the actual leaders people can see are Adam and Eve. This arrangement is why the idea of kings and queens has spread throughout the universe. The Urantia Book says that when Urantia reaches this age, Machiventa Melchizedek, now the vicegerent Planetary Prince, will become the Planetary Sovereign. When even the youngest world in the system has been settled for a thousand years, the next stage begins.
p55.024: When the whole system reaches light and life, the Planetary Sovereigns gather to form a system council, and the system in effect governs itself. Each planet sends ten representatives to the system legislature, and courts are set up at the system capital. The System Sovereign now stays and leads that system forever without being replaced. Also, beings called Midsoniters come and lift up people's minds and spirituality further, just as Adam had lifted up their bodies.
p55.026: When the whole constellation reaches light and life, its government is reorganized once again. The legislative function stops, and a council of System Sovereigns led by the Most Highs takes over that work. These constellations become more and more self-governing as time goes on, and by the seventh stage they gain a true dignity worthy of the name Most High.
p55.027: 10. The Fourth or Local Universe Stage
p55.028: When the whole local universe reaches light and life, that universe enters the superuniverse circuits, and a supreme council made up of one hundred Faithfuls of Days is set up. The very first thing this council does is to recognize the sovereignty of the Creator Son. For the first time, the finaliters also come under an authority other than Paradise.
p55.029: The Creator Son is now set free from the burdens of administration and lives as a closer brother to the glorified finaliters. The Urantia Book carefully says that the Creator Sons may someday go out into the outer universes, and that if so, the Divine Minister would go with them and the Melchizedeks would stay behind.
p55.030: 11. The Minor and Major Sector Stages
p55.031: The minor and major sector stages of the superuniverse are a little different from the affairs of our local universe. It is thought that the minor sector stage has to do mainly with physical balance, and that the major sector stage has to do with a new realization of universe wisdom. None of the seven superuniverses has reached these stages yet.
p55.032: The important point is that even when everything around is still behind, no one can stop the progress of one person or one planet. The Urantia Book says that Jesus of Nazareth, more than nineteen hundred years ago on Urantia, as one human being among others, achieved the status of light and life.
p55.034: No one yet knows for certain what will happen when a whole superuniverse reaches light and life, because it has never happened. It is expected, though, that there will be great changes in all organization, and that the Supreme Being may appear as the sovereign ruler of the completed creation of time and space. It is a story of the far future, but like Jesus, we too can walk toward light and life one step at a time, right here and now.
p56.002: The first sentence of this paper is “⟦Q 56:0.1⟧GOD is unity.⟦/Q⟧” The whole universe is like one vast machine guided by one infinite mind. The world of matter, the world of mind, and the world of spirit are all linked together. Because the perfect and the imperfect are also connected, even we who are imperfect can rise all the way to Paradise, following the Father's call: “⟦Q 56:0.1⟧Be you perfect, even as I am perfect.⟦/Q⟧” To our eyes the universe sometimes looks like a jumble, but those who see more widely see one divine purpose flowing beneath all its variety.
p56.004: The material universe is not endless, but it is perfectly co-ordinated. Force and energy show up in many forms, but their root is all one. The source of the whole material universe is the Isle of Paradise at the center of the universe. And all true matter responds to the gravity centered on Paradise. Gravity works the same way everywhere, without changing.
p56.005: Pure energy and pure spirit in the end all come together as one in the Universal Father. In God there is no reality split into two, matter and spirit, existing separately. The Urantia Book says, “⟦Q 56:1.5⟧in him all things consist⟦/Q⟧”. When matter and spirit seem to us to be split into two, it is mind that links them together.
p56.007: The thought of the Universal Father was expressed in two ways. One is the Eternal Son, and the other is the Isle of Paradise. The one who links these two realities, spirit and matter, is the Infinite Spirit, and what the Infinite Spirit gives is mind. Mind is the essential channel that connects spirit and matter.
p56.008: That is why we, who have material bodies, can recognize and understand the spirit within us only through mind. This universe mind reaches from the mind of the simplest living thing to the minds of the highest beings, yet in the end it is all joined as one in the mind of the Infinite Spirit.
p56.010: Just as mind gathers in the Infinite Spirit, spirit gathers in the Eternal Son. Spiritual beings and spiritual happenings throughout the universe all come from God, who is spirit. In our local universe the Holy Spirit and the Spirit of Truth go out from the headquarters of the Creator Son and reach our minds. And the Thought Adjuster, who comes directly from the Father, lives within us.
p56.011: In this way we receive gifts of spirit from all three, the Father, the Son, and the Infinite Spirit, together. These three are finally joined into one when we become perfected beings. Spirit comes from one, is expressed as three, and in the end becomes one again in the experience of becoming one with God.
p56.013: Personality has the nature of drawing scattered things together into one. The personality of the Universal Father unifies all things, and the personality we received from the Father also has the power to unify body, mind, and spirit into one. This is a sign that our personality came from the Father, and proof that we are still connected with the Father now.
p56.014: God appears in the universe in many forms and on many levels. But to a person who knows God, God is always one, our Father. The Urantia Book says that just as no child can have two fathers, God can never be many to a personality. In the heart that worships, “⟦Q 56:4.5⟧God is one⟦/Q⟧”.
p56.016: The Universal Father, the Eternal Son, and the Infinite Spirit are three persons, but in the Paradise Trinity they are truly one undivided Deity. In our universe today, beings such as the Creator Son and the Creative Spirit, the Ancients of Days, and the Seven Master Spirits carry out the will of God. The Urantia Book points out an important difference. On Paradise the oneness of God is a fact from the very beginning, but in the worlds of time and space that oneness is a goal still being worked out.
p56.018: As the universes of time and space grow, the Supreme Being, who draws the work of the many Creators together into one, gradually comes into view. The Supreme Being can be called God who is growing. We cannot know all of God at once. A being on any level knows God only as much as it is able to understand.
p56.019: So we come to know the God of love little by little, by recognizing truth, sensing beauty, and worshiping goodness. Rising one step at a time in this way, we understand the Supreme Being, and at last we meet the Universal Father on Paradise.
p56.021: Each time a world, a system, or a universe reaches the age of light and life, God is revealed that much more widely and clearly. Growth in one place echoes everywhere else. At first we may experience God's unseen influence before we experience his personality.
p56.022: The Urantia Book says that in the far future new universes will come into being beyond the present universes, and that the Creator Sons may work there. It honestly adds that no one yet knows how the beings there will find their way to God. But it believes that our completed universes will somehow be used in their journey to Paradise.
p56.024: The Supreme Being means three things to us. He is the one who unifies the many forms of God in time and space, he is the greatest God that finite beings can actually understand, and he is the only way to the higher worlds. The finaliters who have reached Paradise come to know the Supreme Being by serving in the superuniverses and gathering experience.
p56.025: The Urantia Book asks us to remember something important. Everything God the Father and his Sons have done for us, we too can give back to our neighbors and to the growing Supreme Being. Love, joy, and service are things we give and receive. Just as Jesus said, “⟦Q 56:8.4⟧The Son does only those things which he sees the Father do.⟦/Q⟧” we too can reveal God by sharing with our neighbors the love we have received.
p56.027: The Urantia Book also takes up deep philosophical questions about the relationship of the Absolutes and the Trinities. These questions are very hard, but the conclusion The Urantia Book reaches is clear: if we follow everything all the way to the end, we finally arrive at the Universal Father. Whatever level we may come to know God on in a new way, each time we will discover the eternal Father once again.
p56.028: The force organizers gather the energies of space, the Creator Sons make inhabited universes out of them, and the beings who grow up in them rise toward the Father in order to become like the Father. The Urantia Book says that the universe is wholly one, that God is in all, and that without God nothing could exist.
p56.030: What people living in the age of light and life seek most eagerly is truth, beauty, and goodness, because these are the three ways we come to know God. Truth is the foundation of science and philosophy, beauty gives birth to art and music, and goodness makes up ethics, morals, and religion. The Urantia Book says that the greatest beauty is the meeting in which man seeks God and God seeks man.
p56.031: In the universe only sin stands isolated. The Urantia Book says, “⟦Q 56:10.14⟧No man lives by himself.⟦/Q⟧” and teaches, as Jesus said, that the one who would be great must serve all. What unites truth, beauty, and goodness is love. This paper ends with a short sentence: “⟦Q 56:10.21⟧Love is the desire to do good to others.⟦/Q⟧” Doing a small good for someone today is living the greatest truth of the universe.
p57.002: This paper tells how the world we live on, Urantia, came to be, drawing on records from the universe archives. The Urantia Book reckons time by the length of the year on our calendar, and it says it will speak in round numbers such as thousands, millions, and billions of years rather than exact dates. The point it counts from is the beginning of the twentieth century.
p57.004: Urantia was born from our sun, and our sun was born from a huge cloud called the Andronover nebula. A nebula is a vast cloud of gas and dust floating in space. About 987 billion years ago, an inspector reported that a certain region of space in the superuniverse of Orvonton was suitable for making matter.
p57.005: Afterward the force organizers from Paradise went there, and about 875 billion years ago they set off a huge whirl of energy. This was the beginning of the Andronover nebula. Once the spinning had begun, the force organizers withdrew, and from then on a new material world grew up in an orderly way according to the nature of energy.
p57.007: Every material world begins as a round cloud of gas. Over time this cloud usually takes a spiral shape, and in the end it gives birth to many suns and planets. The Andronover nebula kept growing and spinning faster and faster, and about 600 billion years ago it reached its greatest size. At that time the nebula was a huge, flat, round cloud of gas.
p57.009: After that the nebula stretched out two great arms and took on a spiral shape. It looked exactly like the spiral nebulae that astronomers see through their telescopes today. As the nebula shrank and spun faster, about 500 billion years ago the first sun broke away from it and moved out into space. Most of the suns of Orvonton were born this way.
p57.010: Around 400 billion years ago, Michael, the Creator Son of Nebadon, chose this nebula as the site on which to build his universe. Building began on Salvington, the capital of the universe, and on many headquarters worlds, and about 200 billion years ago the oldest inhabited worlds of Nebadon came into being. Then, around 100 billion years ago, the struggle between heat and gravity inside the nebula reached its peak.
p57.012: The nebula now began to pour out suns on a grand scale. During the first period of sun dispersal, 876,926 solar systems were born. About 8 billion years ago a last huge explosion began at the center of the nebula, and it went on for nearly two billion years.
p57.013: Then, about 6 billion years ago, our sun was born in this last outburst. In all, 1,013,628 suns were born from the Andronover nebula. The nebula itself is gone now, but its last central remnant still glows red and sends warm light and heat to the one hundred sixty-five worlds around it.
p57.014: 5. Origin of Monmatia—The Urantia Solar System
p57.015: About 4.5 billion years ago, a huge system of heavenly bodies called Angona came near our sun. At its center was a giant dark star that was heavy and had strong gravity. As Angona came closer, its gravity drew flaming gases out of the sun, and finally a huge column of gas, swollen in the middle and thin at both ends, broke away from the sun. Less than one percent of the planetary systems in Orvonton came into being this way.
p57.016: This column of gas cooled and gathered together and became the twelve planets of the solar system. From the thick middle part came Jupiter and Saturn, and at first these two were like small, self-shining suns. From the two ends came the smaller planets. At this time three of Angona's planets were captured by the solar system and collided, and this caused the backward, retrograde motion of some of the moons.
p57.017: 6. The Solar System Stage—The Planet-Forming Era
p57.018: The planets grew bigger and bigger by drawing in meteors wandering through space. The planets closer to the sun slowed their spin because of tidal friction, and this is also why the moon always shows the same face to the earth. Long ago a fifth planet orbiting close to Jupiter was broken apart by Jupiter's gravity and became today's asteroids, and the rings of Saturn are also the remains of a broken-up moon.
p57.019: About 3 billion years ago the solar system began to move much as it does now, and it was registered in Nebadon under the name Monmatia. Two and a half billion years ago Urantia was about one tenth of its present mass, and it was still growing by gathering meteors.
p57.020: 7. The Meteoric Era—The Volcanic Age—The Primitive Planetary Atmosphere
p57.021: At this time the earth had no atmosphere to shield it from meteors, so countless meteors fell straight to the ground. About 2 billion years ago the earth grew big enough to hold an atmosphere, and real volcanic activity began. One and a half billion years ago volcanic activity reached its peak, and the whole earth became a place of fire, but even so, a light granite crust was slowly being formed.
p57.022: The first atmosphere had almost no oxygen. As the atmosphere cooled, rain began to fall on the hot rocks, and for thousands of years a thick blanket of water vapor covered the earth so that sunlight could not reach the ground. Oxygen in the air only began to be produced much later, when plants appeared in the sea.
p57.023: 8. Crustal Stabilization—The Age of Earthquakes—The World Ocean and the First Continent
p57.024: About 1 billion years ago the earth reached nearly its present size and was registered under the name Urantia. As the crust cooled, the water vapor turned into water and covered the whole earth to an average depth of more than a mile, and this first ocean was fresh water, not salty. Nine hundred fifty million years ago there was one great continent and one ocean, and around this time Urantia was assigned to the system of Satania. This was the place that would later, after Michael came, become known as the “⟦Q 57:8.6⟧world of the cross⟦/Q⟧”.
p57.025: Nine hundred million years ago a commission of twenty-four came from Jerusem, and after looking things over they recommended Urantia as a planet for a life experiment. After that the continent rose and broke apart; America drifted off to the west, and Africa and Europe separated. About 650 million years ago the sea came deep into the inland parts of the continents and became salt water, good for living things. These shallow inland seas were the very cradle of life. When we think about this long preparation over billions of years, we can see what a gift this ground we stand on is, made ready with such long and patient care.
p58.002: In the system of Satania there are only sixty-one planets like Urantia, where life is modified and experimented with. On most planets life is planted by the set methods, but about one in ten is chosen as a decimal planet, where the Life Carriers may try experiments that change or improve the standard life of the universe a little. The Life Carriers are Sons of the universe whose task is to plant life on a planet and care for it. Urantia is exactly such an experimental planet.
p58.004: About 600 million years ago the Life Carriers came to Urantia to find out whether life could be planted here. Life can grow only as far as a planet is ready for it, so they could not hurry. Because the life of Urantia was designed to live in salt water, they had to wait until the seas were salty enough.
p58.005: Amazingly, even today a salt water much like that ancient sea flows in our blood inside our bodies and bathes every cell. The Life Carriers waited for the continents to break apart further so that there would be many shallow inland seas and quiet bays. Shallow seas, where sunlight reaches all the way to the bottom, were the best places to plant life.
p58.007: The earth's atmosphere lets through only a very small part of the light the sun sends out. Even so, if you figured that sunlight at the price of electricity, it would cost an enormous amount. A thin ozone layer high in the atmosphere blocks harmful ultraviolet rays, yet lets in just as much ultraviolet light as is needed for health. If this layer had been even a little thicker, we would not have received that good sunlight.
p58.008: The Urantia Book says there are more than forty of these “⟦Q 58:2.4⟧fortuitous⟦/Q⟧” protective arrangements. It also says that the midway creatures have collected more than fifty thousand facts of physics and chemistry showing that the universe was made not by accident but for a wise purpose. The atmosphere holding in the heat at night like a blanket, sunspots making the auroras, and the compass needle moving slightly as it follows the sun are all workings of this atmosphere and the sun.
p58.010: In early space huge clouds of hydrogen were scattered about, and within them atoms were built up and broken down, and powerful space rays poured out. These hydrogen clouds are like the chemical laboratories of the universe, where energy and matter are changed. But the life planted by the Life Carriers was made to stand up to these strong space rays without trouble. Before life was planted, this space environment also had to be just right.
p58.012: Do not be misled by the name Life Carriers. They did not bring life here from somewhere else; they made life right here on Urantia. That is why the life of Urantia is unique, found nowhere else in Nebadon.
p58.013: About 550 million years ago the Life Carriers came again, made the first patterns of life, and planted them in the sea. They planted them in three places at once: the Eurasian-African region, the Australian region, and the American region. They looked ahead so that even when the continents later broke apart, each continent would carry life along with it in warm seas. About 500 million years ago marine plants were well established.
p58.015: The continents kept drifting little by little. The center of the earth is as hard as steel and a little hotter than the surface of the sun. Outside it are heavy metals, and on the very outside are many kinds of rock. The continents float on a hot layer of basalt that has not yet hardened, and if this layer had not acted as a cushion, strong earthquakes would have shattered the world to pieces.
p58.016: Earthquakes come not from volcanoes but from the solid crust slipping and moving. The ocean floors are made of heavier rock than the continents, so the lighter continents can float on top. But because the push of the continents is greater than the push of the sea water, the continents tend to slide slowly toward the oceans.
p58.018: About 450 million years ago, in the shallow, warm seas, the change from plant life to animal life took place. This change was the slow unfolding of what had already been placed within the first patterns of life. Even today there are slime molds, which are hard to tell apart as plant or animal.
p58.019: The Urantia Book says that new species do not appear through small changes piling up little by little, but suddenly, fully formed, at a certain time. This is not a miracle but a purely natural biologic event. The Urantia Book also explains that mind does not arise by itself out of the evolution of the body, but is a gift given by the adjutant mind-spirits, suited to the capacity of the brain. Life keeps striving all the time to fit itself to an ever-changing environment.
p58.021: The story of this age is recorded in the fossils in the rocks. The oldest rock layers hold fossils of simple living things such as algae and sponges. At Lake Superior and the Grand Canyon in America, the rock layers of this distant age are easy to see, and in a valley in Wisconsin there are traces of lava that flowed and piled up one hundred twenty-seven times. In this period the lava brought iron, copper, and lead up near the surface.
p58.022: In this age life spread through the seas of the whole world, the floors of the shallow seas were filled with plants as thick as grass, and the shores were crowded with simple animals. The Urantia Book calls the rock layers the vast “⟦Q 58:7.12⟧stone book⟦/Q⟧” and says that if we only learn how to read it, it tells the truth. When we think that, as the poet The Urantia Book quotes put it, “⟦Q 58:7.12⟧The dust we tread upon was once alive.⟦/Q⟧” we can feel that even a handful of soil beneath our feet holds a long history of life.
p59.002: This paper is the history of life on earth as told by a Life Carrier (a heavenly being who plants life on a planet and cares for it). The history of Urantia began about a billion years ago and has passed through five eras: the era before life, the era when life had just begun, the marine-life era, the early land-life era, and the mammalian era. Of these, the marine-life era lasted two hundred fifty million years and takes up a quarter of the earth's history; it is the time scientists call the Paleozoic.
p59.003: When this era began, the sea bottoms and shallow shores were covered with rich plant life, and simple animals spread out along the coastlines. From this time on, the great “⟦Q 59:0.8⟧stone book⟦/Q⟧”, that is, the layers of rock holding fossils that record the history of life, began to be written page by page.
p59.004: 1. Early Marine Life in the Shallow Seas—The Trilobite Age
p59.005: At first life was found only in the seas and along the shores. Then plants began for the first time to creep up onto the land. And suddenly the trilobites, the first many-celled animals, appeared and ruled the seas for a long time. Trilobites could not swim well, so they crawled along the bottom, and when an enemy came they curled up. Some kinds could live by eating only the minerals in the mud, so they flourished greatly.
p59.006: During this period the land slowly sank and then rose again, over and over. The climate was warm and evenly shaped by the seas, and thanks to warm ocean currents, even Greenland, now covered with ice, was a tropical paradise. In the seas lived seaweeds, sponges, crustaceans such as shrimp and crabs, and clamlike brachiopods. Scientists call these fifty million years the Cambrian period.
p59.007: 2. The First Continental Flood Stage—The Invertebrate-Animal Age
p59.008: In the next period almost every continent except central Asia was covered again and again by shallow seas. At this time lime-making seaweeds laid down thick limestone, and in North America one of the greatest volcanic eruptions in the world took place. There was still too much carbon dioxide in the air for air-breathing animals to live, and all animals lived in the sea.
p59.009: This period was a time of great development for animals without backbones. The trilobites multiplied into tens of thousands of kinds, and some had as many as four thousand eyes. The ancestors of the corals, jellyfish, and sea worms flourished, and the cephalopods, ancestors of the octopus and squid, along with snails, clams, and oysters, also appeared at this time and have come down to the present day. This period is called the Ordovician.
p59.010: 3. The Second Great Flood Stage—The Coral Period—The Brachiopod Age
p59.011: Once more a great sea covered Europe and North America. There were so many living things with lime shells that their shells piled up on the sea floor and became thick layers of limestone, and the rock over which Niagara Falls now flows was formed at this time. Much gas, oil, and salt come from the deposits of this age; countless sunken animals and plants became their raw material. Great mountain ranges such as the Himalayas and the Caledonian mountains began to form.
p59.012: The trilobites quickly declined, and cephalopods growing up to fifteen feet long became the masters of the sea. Coral reefs also increased greatly. At the end of this period water scorpions appeared, and soon afterward true scorpions that breathed air came on the scene. This period is called the Silurian.
p59.013: 4. The Great Land-Emergence Stage—The Vegetative Land-Life Period—The Age of Fishes
p59.014: Now comes the age when the land wins. As the seas drew back, the bare land began to be covered with green. Ferns suddenly appeared in great numbers and spread over the world, and soon trees forty feet tall grew and formed the first great forests. Those forests had no leaves, so there was not even the sound of rustling in the wind; they were “⟦Q 59:4.17⟧silent forests⟦/Q⟧”.
p59.015: In the sea the most important event took place: the first animals with backbones, the fishes, suddenly appeared. Fishes developed from crustacean ancestors, and some fishes were as long as thirty feet. Today's sharks are descendants of these ancient fishes. Fishes soon adapted to both fresh water and salt water. This age of fishes, which lasted about fifty million years, is called the Devonian.
p59.016: 5. The Crustal-Shifting Stage—The Fern-Forest Carboniferous Period—The Age of Frogs
p59.017: With the appearance of the fishes, the evolution of sea life reached its peak, and now land life becomes more important. When the seas had spread their widest, the first land animals suddenly appeared. The swim bladder of the fish changed into a lung, and so came the amphibians, which live both in the water and on land. Snails, scorpions, and frogs crawled out of the sea onto the land. The fact that frogs still lay their eggs in water and begin life as tadpoles shows this history. That is why this period is called the age of frogs.
p59.018: Soon insects appeared. There were dragonflies with wings thirty inches across and a thousand kinds of cockroaches. While the land kept rising and falling, the lush fern forests of the coastal swamps were sunk under water, pressed down, and turned into coal. That is why this period is called the Carboniferous. Near the end of this period, as the land rose higher, the mild sea climate began to change into a changeable continental climate.
p59.019: 6. The Climatic Transition Stage—The Seed-Plant Period—The Age of Biologic Tribulation
p59.020: Next came a time of great trial for life. As the seas shrank and the land rose high, the climate grew harsh, and new conditions of glaciers and dryness appeared. The sea water grew colder too. At the end of the marine-life era there had been more than a hundred thousand species, but by the end of this period fewer than five hundred were left. The sea animals took refuge in what are now the Gulf of Mexico, the Gangetic Gulf of India, and the Sicilian Gulf of the Mediterranean, and the new species that arose there later filled the seas again.
p59.021: In this hard time the seed plants, which bear seeds, first appeared and became better food for animals, and insects learned to rest dormant to survive winter and drought. In Africa the frogs took the first step in evolving into reptiles. This trial left only the life that had the strength to survive, and made it the ancestor of the more advanced life of the next age. With this Permian period the Paleozoic comes to an end. The sea, like a mother, held and raised the early life, and now the stage of evolution moves onto the land. The fact that hardship actually raised up stronger life gives a little courage to our own lives as well.
